newsitem.title: UK: BAe at record as reports raise order hopes.
newsitem.headline: BAe at record as reports raise order hopes.

text.p: Shares in British Aerospace Plc nudged to a record high on Tuesday as separate press reports raised hopes for a U.S. defence order and a major Chinese order for Airbus jets, for which Bae makes the wings, traders said.
The stock was up 8p at 13.02-1/2 by 0917 GMT, after earlier rising as high as 13.05 stg -- surpassing its previous peak of 13.00 stg set January 17. Volume was a thin 118,197 shares.

A report in the Times quoted UK Defence Secretary Michael Portillo as saying the U.S. Marine Corps was close to placing an order worth several hundred million dollars for howitzers from British companies working together with U.S. firms.
It said Bae and Vickers were the remaining contenders for the order. Vickers shares however were unchanged at 271-1/2p.
Separately, a report in the Wall Street Journal said Airbus was in talks with the Chinese government that French reports suggested could be for as many as 100 aircraft.
"There are a couple of positive press stories out there today," said one trader.
A spokesman for Bae said it was company policy to not comment on possible future orders.
